user_query: I'm a music producer and I'm looking for inspiration for my next track. Can you provide me with the genre of a specific editorial on Deezer? Additionally, fetch the details of a popular song on Soundcloud and give me the information about its artist.

TaskList.description: Fetch the genre of a specific editorial from Deezer.
Fetch the details of a popular song from Soundcloud.
Extract the information about the artist from the song details fetched from Soundcloud.
